title: Rapidly scaling online storage to serve over 1 billion ChatGPT users (Part I)
summary: Traces Habitat's tail stalls to asyncio scheduling delay and LIFO pool reuse, then caps per-process load and uses FIFO.

title: Supercomputer networking to accelerate large scale AI training
summary: Stops link failures from crashing training with MRC, which sprays packets over many SRv6 paths and drops lossy ones.

title: How OpenAI delivers low-latency voice AI at scale
summary: Avoids per-session UDP ports, a poor fit for Kubernetes, with a stateless relay routing WebRTC by the ICE ufrag.

title: Scaling PostgreSQL to power 800 million ChatGPT users
summary: Shields a single Postgres primary from MVCC-amplified write spikes by moving write-heavy workloads to Cosmos DB.
